channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kelvin Sampson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kelvin Sampson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin McHale on Kelvin Sampson
item.description:
Mark Berman:Kevin McHale on Kelvin Sampson:

“He would be a tremendous (NBA) head coach. I would miss him. I really rely on Kelvin a lot. Great coach.”

Kevin McHale on Kelvin Sampson, May 7, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Leslie Alexander on Kelvin Sampson
item.description:
Mark Berman:Leslie Alexander on possibly losing ass't Kelvin Sampson:

“Kelvin is a good coach. We hate to lose anybody,but people have a right 2 move up”

Leslie Alexander on Kelvin Sampson, May 4, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kevin McHale, Kelvin Sampson
item.description:
“He's our leader. He's our voice. But coach Sampson did a good job coming in, and we played hard. Obviously we can't wait for coach McHale to come back. Everybody around here loves him to death.”

Jeremy Lin on Kevin McHale, Kelvin Sampson, Nov 11, 2012. Source: USA Today.
